args.draft_reply:
Hi Eris,

Thanks for reaching out. Yes, Ledgerline can help: it automates invoice intake, approval workflows, and AP reporting, and Xero is a published integration.

On list pricing, Starter is $249/month (up to 5 users, 500 invoices/month) and Growth is $899/month (up to 25 users, 5,000 invoices/month). Your 60 employees don't all need seats, so plan fit depends on how many people will approve or process invoices and your monthly invoice volume.

I can't confirm a delivery date, custom terms, or net-90 payment in this email. Those need review by our team, and I can't promise an outcome. I can ask them to look at the request once we know your needs.

Next step: could you tell me how many approvers/users you'd have and roughly how many invoices you process each month?

Best regards,
Ledgerline
